mission_verify.description: Read actual state independently and evaluate exact predicates. contract object or JSON STRING: {kind:"json",source:{tool:"host_read_file",arguments:{path:"..."}},expected:{"/port":8091},types:{"/port":"integer"},baseline_source:{tool:"host_read_file",arguments:{path:"original.json"}},preserve:["/label","/preserve"]}. kind text requires equals or sha256; service requires source host_service is-active and expected_state. PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL/INSUFFICIENT; never a keyword check. Usable from skills.

mission_report_facts.description: Read factual ledger: actors, tools, parameters, observed receipts, plan versions, semantic verdicts and Codex interventions. Use before report; narrative is not evidence.

mission_action.description: Execute existing host/skill tool with durable operation_key. Identical success reuses receipt across restart; different parameters need a new key. Unknown/failed effect requires a fresh mission_verify FAIL retry_evidence_id. Verify actual state afterwards; cached success is not current state.
